notes.title: Patch 2: Notes.
notes.notes:
Hi All, 

Here comes the patch notes for the second update. 

Bug fixes

1. The keybinding issue should be fixed. 
2. fixed some small UI issues. 
3. Fixed a bug with the final boss. 
4. fixed a bug with the [spoiler]wasp. [/spoiler] 
5. Fixed a bug with the small werewolf.

Gameplay changes 
1. Can no longer be stun-locked by the [spoiler] magpie and dragon. [/spoiler] 


Story
1. Made a small change to make the story clearer. 

Thanks everybody who have played the game and given feedback.

notes.title: Patch 1: Notes.
notes.notes:
Patch 1: Notes. 

Bug fixes 

1. Fixed some bugs with the small monkey.
2. Fixed a bug with disappearing keys.
3. Fixed one game breaking bug at the "final" boss.

Gameplay Changes 

1. Made it harder to cheese the "final" boss.
2. Players can no longer run quicker than the Dragonrider.
3. Players can no longer avoid fighting the Necromancer.


Main known bugs that I am still working on. 

1. Keybindings for keyboard does not always stay saved. 
2. F12 Screenshots are not working. (fixed)
3. The body of the player sometimes disappear when dead.


Thanks everybody who have played the game!

Jens Kolhammar

notes.title: New version of Demo is out
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:
1. The collision system on solid object have been reworked
2. Mid attack of goat, high attack of bear and monkey should connect with player 
3. Even enemies that do not react to a counter the counter animation (in different color) will be shown. 
4. Cannot walk under the shaman shield anymore
5. Bear and Goat fight should be less buggy (more testing needed) 
6. Bigger arrow to show that you can go inside the cave

(notes: no big changes to the shield for the shaman. I think the players who miss the shaman is because the sword does not reach but I will do more testing)

Thanks everybody who helped and found bugs!
